order_connection_assembler.scope: Saved A04 acceptance and independent effective order/work authority to A05 configuration

purchase_chain_entry.scope: Original same-run A05 purchase planning through independent task/order registration binding to A06 upstream delivery reconciliation

purchase_reconciliation_entry.scope: Explicit synthetic purchase task and independent upstream order/delivery/receipt reconciliation

planning_request_entries.scope: Explicit non-plan request payloads, original independent offer/terms/procurement authority and proposed delivery window; native effects unproven

revised_planning_entry.scope: Explicit prior plan and replacement commitments; retains unrelated commitments in complete resource ledger

mixed_planning_entry.scope: Explicit partition of six panels into three manufactured and three purchased; complete independent native registration supplied, execution unverified

mixed_chain_entry.scope: One original A05 split plan, complete native registration bound separately to independent manufacture and purchase A06 selections

mixed_task_registration.scope: Both selections retain identical complete two-task native formation, with independent A06 operations and journals

order_material_chain_entry.scope: Original same-run A04 acceptance through independent effective-order binding, planning, production, quality, logistics, receiving and Contractor material input

planning_material_chain_entry.scope: Original same-run A05 planning through registered production, quality, logistics, receiving and Contractor material input

planning_connection_assembler.scope: Saved original A05 to independent complete task formation and A06 configuration

material_connection_entry.scope: Supplier A09 original response to Contractor A07 material-input provenance; upstream V4 chain pending

logistics_connection_entry.scope: Saved A08 provenance to A09 and subsequent Contractor material connection; no native effects

logistics_material_chain_entry.scope: Original same-run A08 journal to independent A09 receipt and Contractor A07 material-input provenance; order/production/quality upstream pending

quality_logistics_material_chain_entry.scope: Original same-run A07 to independent release/A08 to A09 and Contractor material input; upstream order/production pending

production_material_chain_entry.scope: Original chronological same-run A06/A07/A08/A09 and Contractor material-input provenance; upstream order/task/planning pending
